title: Hermes Agent Tool Schema — Pouch Cost Simulator / Kanei Quotation Lifecycle

sourceOfTruth.repositoryRule: This repository is the implementation SSOT. The NAS receives copies only; NAS copies never edit app behavior.

server.baseUrlPolicy: HTTPS origin of the deployed Next.js app. Configure per environment; never HTTP, never a NAS-hosted app instance.

authentication.tokenStorageRule: Token value is injected from Hermes-side secret storage at call time. Never paste, log, copy, or persist token values into repository files, NAS artifacts, or tool transcripts.
authentication.sessionPolicy: No cookie/session authentication in production. The agent credential is the only production identity.

constraints: Active, non-admin user bound to the credential
Credential stores only a SHA-256 token hash server-side
Token is 48 random bytes (base64url), expiry-bound, revocable, rotatable, rate-limited, audited

scopeCatalog.calculate:run: Run server calculation and receive server-authored internalActor/customerSafe projections.
scopeCatalog.quote:issue: Request server-side canonical issuance of a new Kanei-owned quotation.
scopeCatalog.email_draft:read: Read Kanei email drafts without dispatch.
scopeCatalog.approval_state:read: Read internal/customer approval evidence state for Kanei-owned quotations.
scopeCatalog.internal_approval:request: Request policy-gated internal approval. Privileged; stripped at credential creation unless explicitly enabled via includeInternalApproval.

tools.name: credential_status
tools.purpose: Verify the credential is active and list its granted scopes before running workflow tools.

tools.name: calculate
tools.purpose: Run the shared server calculation core and receive separate internalActor and customerSafe projections. Never reimplement pricing locally.

request.forbiddenInputPolicy: Any forbidden field present anywhere in the request body is rejected with 400 client_pricing_authority_rejected before calculation.

tools.sideEffects: Gravure (Y/K) requests persist a durable pricing snapshot server-side; the response returns only redacted snapshot metadata.

tools.name: issue_kanei_quote
tools.purpose: Request server-side issuance of a new Kanei-owned quotation with KT-YYYYMM-NNN numbering and a deterministic canonical PDF. The server re-derives and verifies all calculation and customer-facing amounts.

headers.Idempotency-Key: Required. Pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{15,127}$; bound to credential + request fingerprint.

shape.calculationRequest: CalculationInput from the calculate tool (client pricing-authority fields rejected)
shape.calculationChecklist: server snapshot from the calculate flow (injection keys rejected)
shape.issue: customer-facing issue fields (server-validated; pricing/margin fields rejected)

tools.sideEffects: Creates quotation + canonical PDF atomically; never dispatches mail; never issues customer tokens.

tools.name: read_kanei_quote
tools.purpose: Read a redacted summary of an authorized Kanei-owned quotation.

tools.name: read_kanei_email_draft
tools.purpose: Read the owner-domain email draft for an authorized Kanei-owned quotation. Retrieval never sends mail.

shape.subject: string
shape.pdf: metadata only (fileName, sha256, byteLength); no PDF bytes

tools.sideEffects: None. Mail dispatch stays with the human operator.

tools.name: read_customer_approval_state
tools.purpose: Read durable, evidence-derived approval state for an authorized Kanei-owned quotation. Chat or email text is never accepted as customer approval.

response.evidenceRule: customer_approved requires source=customer_token written by the verified customer-token route. owner_domain evidence is reported separately and never conflated with token evidence.

tools.name: request_internal_approval
tools.purpose: Request autonomous internal approval for a Kanei-owned draft quotation. Fails closed unless the separately enabled policy evaluator and credential scope both allow it.
tools.scopeBinding: Route-level auth runs first; the scope check and full policy evaluator run inside requestInternalApproval. Credentials without this scope receive 403 forbidden_scope.
tools.sideEffects: On allow: invokes the existing approveQuotationGate and film-order synchronization. Every allow and block is durably audited.

tools.name: escalate
tools.purpose: Hand off to the responsible human (mail dispatch, customer-token completion, policy exception, blocked approval, or security event). This is a client-side workflow step with no server endpoint.
behavior: Produce a short handoff note: quotationId/number when present, tool that blocked, machine-readable error reason, and the next human action.
Never include bearer tokens, approval token bytes, session cookies, or full customer email bodies in the handoff.
Stop the autonomous workflow for this quotation after escalating a policy block or security event.

forbiddenOperations.policy: No tool definitions, endpoints, scopes, or improvised calls may exist for any of the following. The bearer credential is not accepted outside /api/agent/v1.
list: shell or local filesystem access on the app host
portal v1 or user/session API access
running an app instance on the NAS as a replacement for the deployed app
